name: General Modular Graphs (GMG)
description: A generative benchmark network model that produces graphs with modular/community structure to test and compare community detection algorithms.
evaluation_method: Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) / Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) / modularity
general_score_metric: NMI / ARI (primary metrics for community detection quality)
reputation: A synthetic benchmark model used in network-science and graph-ML evaluations; recognized in the community for producing controlled modular graphs but not a mainstream large-scale benchmark.
notes: Synthetic data generator (not real-world data); results are highly dependent on generator parameters (e.g., community strength) which can lead to inflated or non-transferable scores; non-LLM benchmark.
